property_summary: For all calls to sendTo(receiver, amount) from the owner, the reference contract always reverts when amount == 0 (does not perform a zero-value transfer), whereas the mutant allows amount == 0 and thus will succeed for some inputs; the property: sendTo must revert for zero amounts.
change_summary: Changed amount check to allow zero amounts (removed >0 requirement), permitting zero-value transfers that may differ in behaviour.
